separability_note: Ca is a records claim whose legs read the round's own instruments and receipts (SEQ leg reads the C/O/Ca counter sources; dispositions read committed manifests and corpus files). Expected separability findings: Ca->C and Ca->O via counter reads (record-dependency class only: Ca asserts the counters' structure, never their measured outputs); Ca->REC via lands-time disposition legs over records committed in the lands commit. A complete run is filed at reports/round-67/telemetry/separability-real.txt via the bounded checker (round-66 O capability).
receipt_protocol: QUALITY criterion 19 / R66-D3 fix: every r67 counter requires --lands <40hex>; the receipt records the stamped revision (--lands), the evaluated revision (`git rev-parse main` of --root), the measured revision (same run), the lands tree hash and the counter's sha256; leg STAMP fails unless evaluated == stamped. Evaluations run inside a materialized clone at the lands commit (`git clone --no-local`), never on a worktree that may have moved past the stamp. Carrier-parentage is post-records evidence (check-receipt-seq.py --topo, committed as reports/round-67/telemetry/post-records.txt), never a lands-time leg. The declared command is run as `--root <clone> --lands <lands>`; the pre-landing dry run materializes the BASE revision and runs `--lands <base>`.
